items.title_en: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 发布
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's latest iteration in the Gemini family, promising faster inference and smoother real-time interactions. The update aims to empower more responsive AI applications and better developer tooling, reinforcing Google's push to compete with other high-end LLMs.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 是谷歌 Gemini 系列的最新版本，承诺提升推理速度与实时交互的流畅度。该更新旨在为更快速的 AI 应用和更完善的开发工具提供支持，凸显谷歌在高端大模型领域的竞争策略。

items.title_en: Muse Spark 1.3
items.title_zh: Muse Spark 1.3
items.summary_en: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 release brings improvements in efficiency and safety at scale, with updated tooling for developers and better inference performance. The update signals Meta's continued push to provide accessible AI tools for both on-device and cloud workflows.
items.summary_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.3，提升在大规模部署中的效率与安全性，并带来改进的开发者工具与推理性能。此次更新体现了 Meta 持续推动为开发者提供更易用的 AI 工具，覆盖云端与本地工作流。

items.title_en: A note on subscription prices from LWN
items.title_zh: 关于 LWN 订阅价格的一些说明
items.summary_en: LWN addresses pricing strategy for subscriptions, possibly changes, value, and tiers; implications for readers who rely on high-quality open-source journalism.
items.summary_zh: LWN 对订阅价格进行了说明，讨论了定价策略、价值与分层等问题，并影响依赖其高质量开源新闻的读者。

items.title_en: Dutch central bank moves 86 tonnes of gold from US citing 'geopolitical unrest'
items.title_zh: 荷兰央行因地缘政治动荡将86吨黄金从美国运回
items.summary_en: The Dutch central bank moved 86 tonnes of gold from the US due to geopolitical unrest, illustrating how reserve diversification and security concerns shape central-bank decisions.
items.summary_zh: 荷兰央行因地缘政治动荡将86吨黄金从美国运回，凸显央行在储备多元化与安全性方面的考量。

items.title_en: I wanna live an NPC life
items.title_zh: 我想过NPC 生活
items.summary_en: Explores the appeal of living as an NPC in a world of AI and hyperconnectivity, using the term as a metaphor for autonomy and authenticity. It discusses boundaries between human agency and automated systems.
items.summary_zh: 以“NPC 生活”为喻，探讨在 AI 与高度互联的时代，追求简约、可预设生活的吸引力与边界。文章反思人类自主性与自动化系统之间的关系。

items.title_en: Fable 5.1 World Modeling
items.title_zh: Fable 5.1 的世界建模
items.summary_en: Fable 5.1 introduces world modeling capabilities, enabling agents to build internal representations of their environments and simulate outcomes for planning. It highlights modular 'worlds' that support scalable reasoning and generalization across tasks. For developers, this signals a shift toward more sample-efficient, model-based approaches in interactive AI systems.
items.summary_zh: Fable 5.1 引入世界建模能力，使代理能够构建环境的内部表示并对结果进行仿真以便规划。它强调支持跨任务的可扩展推理与通用化的模块化“世界”概念。对开发者而言，标志着向更高效、基于模型的交互式 AI 系统迈进。

items.title_en: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
items.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.1 与 Claude Mythos 5.1
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, minor updates to its Claude family. The changes focus on safety, reliability, and improved tool-using capabilities in chat and coding workflows, which may influence how developers integrate Claude into apps. Users should test for behavior changes, prompt handling tweaks, and any impacts on latency or pricing.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.1 与 Claude Mythos 5.1，强调安全性、可靠性和改进的工具使用能力。此举可能影响开发者在构建基于 Claude 的应用时的提示设计、令牌消耗与延迟。请尽早评估新版本的行为变化。

items.title_en: Google avoids a breakup of its ad tech business
items.title_zh: 谷歌避免分拆其广告技术业务
items.summary_en: Google has avoided a forced breakup of its ad tech business through regulatory remedies, preserving its integrated ad tech stack. The decision shapes competition in online advertising and signals how regulators approach platform ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌通过监管性方案维持广告技术业务的整合结构，避免被拆分。这一走向影响在线广告的竞争格局，也反映监管机构在平台生态上的取舍。

items.title_en: Three sites made 215,128 “best software” pages for AI. Perplexity cites them
items.title_zh: 三家站点为 AI 制作了 215,128 个“最佳软件”页面，Perplexity 引用它们
items.summary_en: Three sites collectively produced 215,128 pages labeled 'best software' used by AI systems, according to a Trellner report cited by Perplexity. The finding raises concerns about data provenance, the quality of training sources, and how such manufactured sources may shape AI recommendations.
items.summary_zh: 三家站点合计制作了 215,128 个标注为“最佳软件”的页面，被 AI 系统使用，据 Trellner 的报告被 Perplexity 引用。此发现引发对数据来源、训练源质量的担忧，以及制造性来源如何影响 AI 推荐的可能性。

items.title_en: Can I opt out of my input or output data being used for training?
items.title_zh: 我可以选择不让我的输入或输出数据被用于训练吗？
items.summary_en: The article explains whether you can opt out of having your inputs or model outputs used to train AI systems, and how to exercise privacy controls with mistral.ai.
items.summary_zh: 本文解释是否可选择将自己的输入或输出数据用于训练，以及如何在 mistral.ai 的平台上行使隐私控制和数据偏好。

items.title_en: I Don't Have a Smartphone
items.title_zh: 我没有智能手机
items.summary_en: A personal take on living without a smartphone, discussing tradeoffs, privacy, and how digital life changes when you disconnect from mobile ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 作者分享不使用智能手机的生活方式，探讨隐私、自由度与数字生活在不使用手机时的取舍与影响。

items.title_en: Mamdani Bans AI in NYC Schools
items.title_zh: Mamdani 在纽约市学校禁止使用 AI
items.summary_en: Reports that NYC schools are banning AI tools, prompting debates about pedagogy, safety, and equity in classrooms. The policy move has implications for teachers, students, and edtech vendors, shaping how AI is integrated into curricula.
items.summary_zh: 报道称纽约市学校正在禁止使用 AI 工具，引发关于教学方法、安全性与教育公平性的讨论。这一政策对教师、学生及教育科技厂商影响深远，也将影响 AI 在课程中的应用方式。

items.title_en: Paint.net 5.2 alpha now runs on Linux
items.title_zh: Paint.net 5.2 alpha 现已在 Linux 上运行
items.summary_en: An alpha build of Paint.net now runs on Linux, signaling improving cross-platform support. Expect early bugs and performance caveats as developers evaluate porting approach.
items.summary_zh: Paint.net 5.2 的 α 版现已在 Linux 上运行，标志着跨平台支持的进展，但仍可能存在早期 bug 和性能问题。

items.title_en: Biggest dark matter detector spots a single weird particle
items.title_zh: 全球最大暗物质探测器观测到一个异常粒子
items.summary_en: A flagship dark matter detector recorded an unusual event that could be either a background glitch or a hint of new physics. The finding underscores the need for careful cross-checks, calibration, and independent verification before claiming discoveries.
items.summary_zh: 一台世界最大规模的暗物质探测器记录到一次异常事件，可能是背景噪声，也可能暗示新物理。此类发现需要严格的复核、标定与独立验证才能成为可靠的物理信号。

items.title_en: Hang on to Your Firefox
items.title_zh: 坚持使用你的 Firefox
items.summary_en: Firefox continues to offer strong privacy protections and a modular extension ecosystem at a time of rapid browser changes. The piece argues that users don’t have to switch to alternative engines to get modern features, emphasizing Mozilla’s open web commitments and ongoing performance improvements. It also provides practical tips for getting the most out of Firefox.
items.summary_zh: Firefox 仍然是注重隐私的用户的可行选择，浏览器生态在快速演进。文章强调无需放弃 Firefox 就能获得现代功能，突出 Mozilla 的开放网络承诺与持续的性能改进。文中还给出如何最大化使用 Firefox 的实用建议。

items.title_en: Exit the Cave
items.title_zh: 走出洞穴
items.summary_en: Step out of the cave: shift from insular rhetoric to evidence-based understanding of technology.
items.summary_zh: 走出洞穴：从闭塞叙事转向以证据为基础的技术理解。

items.title_en: Aging brains blend memories together instead of just forgetting them
items.title_zh: 衰老大脑把记忆混合在一起，而非单纯遗忘
items.summary_en: New research suggests aging brains may blend memories across events, reshaping how we recall the past. Implications include misremembering and potential parallels for AI memory models.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示年迈大脑可能把不同事件的记忆混在一起，影响回忆。对记忆机制的理解、以及与 AI 记忆模型的比喻都具有启发性。

items.title_en: It's Like Having 150 Extra Engineers
items.title_zh: 就像多出150名工程师
items.summary_en: A historical photo and context about IBM's expansion of its engineering workforce in 1951, illustrating how large teams accelerated early computing progress.
items.summary_zh: 一张历史照片及背景，展示 IBM 1951 年扩充工程师队伍的情景，说明大规模团队加速早期计算发展的作用。

items.title_en: Commodore 64 released September 1, 1982
items.title_zh: Commodore 64 于1982年9月1日发布
items.summary_en: The Commodore 64, released in 1982, became one of the best-selling home computers due to its balance of price, performance, and a robust software library. Its 64KB RAM, built-in sound, and broad ecosystem helped popularize gaming and home computing, shaping the era’s tech culture.
items.summary_zh: Commodore 64于1982年发布，以性价比、性能与丰富的软件生态著称，成为最畅销的家用电脑之一。64K内存、出众的声音特性和庞大的软件生态推动了游戏与家庭计算的普及，深刻影响了80年代的科技文化。

items.title_en: How accurate have Ed Zitron's AI skeptic predictions been?
items.title_zh: 艾德·齐特龙的 AI 怀疑论预测有多准确？
items.summary_en: A retrospective assessment evaluates how accurate Ed Zitron's AI-skeptic predictions have been, comparing past forecasts with now-established AI realities. It highlights patterns in tech prognostication and biases, offering takeaways about forecasting in tech journalism.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾性评估知名公关人士 Ed Zitron 对 AI 的怀疑性预测的准确性，将其以往的判断与当前 AI 现实进行对比，揭示科技预测中的规律与偏差，并提出对读者的启示。

items.title_en: Reasons robotics is hard
items.title_zh: 机器人为何难以实现：十四条原因
items.summary_en: A concise list of 14 fundamental challenges in robotics, from perception and control to system integration, safety, and real-world deployment hurdles.
items.summary_zh: 总结了机器人领域的14个核心难点，涵盖感知、控制、系统集成、安全性以及落地部署等方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Qantas Airbus A380 engine failure in 2010 (2023)
items.title_zh: 2010 年 Qantas A380 发动机故障（2023 年回顾）
items.summary_en: This retrospective revisits a 2010 engine failure on a Qantas A380, examining root causes, maintenance practices, and lessons for airline safety and regulatory oversight. It connects historical incidents to modern reliability expectations for large turbofan engines.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 2010 年 Qantas A380 的发动机故障，分析根本原因、维护实践与对航空安全及监管的启示。将历史事件与对大型涡扇发动机的可靠性期望联系起来，并强调微小公差与检修制度在大规模运营中的重要性。

items.title_en: GrapheneOS says Pixel 11 has MTE support after all
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS 称 Pixel 11 终于支持 MTE
items.summary_en: Memory Tagging Extension improves memory safety; enabling MTE on Pixel 11 strengthens defense against certain exploits. The post clarifies how to enable it and what it means for app developers and end users.
items.summary_zh: MTE 提升内存安全，Pixel 11 启用后能更好防御某些利用漏洞。文中说明如何开启，以及对应用开发者和用户意味着什么。

items.title_en: AnkiDroid: Google Play no longer allowing Open Collective donation link
items.title_zh: AnkiDroid：Google Play 不再允许 Open Collective 捐赠链接
items.summary_en: Google Play no longer allows apps to link to external donation pages such as Open Collective, forcing AnkiDroid to remove its donation link. This policy shift illustrates how app-store rules can constrain OSS funding models and push developers toward alternative monetization or sponsorship approaches. For a long-running open-source Android project, sustaining funding remains a critical challenge.
items.summary_zh: Google Play 现在不再允许应用链接到外部捐赠页面，AnkiDroid 团队因此移除了 Open Collective 的捐赠链接。这一政策变化凸显了应用商店规则对开源资金模式的制约，可能促使开发者转向应用内购买或平台赞助等替代模式。对于长期运营的开源 Android 项目来说，资金筹措仍然是关键挑战。

items.title_en: Dutch central bank moves share of gold from U.S., Canada to London
items.title_zh: 荷兰央行将部分黄金储备从美加转移至伦敦
items.summary_en: The Dutch central bank is moving a portion of its gold reserves from the US and Canada to London, citing instability and geopolitical risk. The relocation reflects central banks' diversification of storage locations, with potential implications for bullion markets and international finance.
items.summary_zh: 荷兰央行将部分黄金储备从美国与加拿大转移至伦敦，称原因是金融不稳定与地缘风险。这一举动体现央行储备地理分散的趋势，可能对全球金条市场与国际金融产生影响。

items.title_en: Six curl CVEs after OpenAI and Anthropic came back with zero
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Anthropic 回应零漏洞后，curl 仍出现六个 CVE
items.summary_en: Security researchers found six CVEs in curl after major AI companies reported zero vulnerabilities. Highlights ongoing need for proactive auditing, patch cycles, and supply-chain security in ubiquitous tooling.
items.summary_zh: 在两家 AI 巨头报告零漏洞后，curl 仍披露六个 CVE，强调对广泛使用工具持续进行主动审计、补丁更新和供应链安全的重要性。

items.title_en: Poisson Disk Sampling
items.title_zh: 泊松盘采样
items.summary_en: Explains Poisson disk sampling as a method to generate evenly distributed points without clustering, useful for graphics, spatial sampling, and ML visualization. Includes intuition and practical tips.
items.summary_zh: 介绍泊松盘采样，生成均匀、无聚簇的点分布，广泛用于图形、空间采样和可视化。给出直观解释与实用建议。

items.title_en: Launch HN: RonanRX (YC S26) – Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
items.title_zh: RonanRX（YC S26）——个性化肽类与 GLP-1 药物
items.summary_en: A YC-backed startup, RonanRX, focuses on personalized peptide therapies and GLP-1 treatments, signaling a move toward tailored biotech solutions and raising questions about safety and regulation.
items.summary_zh: 由 YC 支持的 RonanRX 专注于个性化肽类疗法和 GLP-1 药物，标志着生物技术定制化的趋势，同时也引发安全性与监管方面的关注。

items.title_en: Play Store blocks AuroraStore, hurting GrapheneOS users
items.title_zh: Play 商店封锁 AuroraStore，GrapheneOS 用户受影响
items.summary_en: Google blocks Aurora Store, limiting access for GrapheneOS users who rely on Aurora as an alternative to Google Play Services. This move heightens tensions between privacy-focused Android forks and Google's control of app distribution. It underscores ongoing battles over who gets to decide what runs on Android devices.
items.summary_zh: Google 封禁 Aurora Store，影响依赖 Aurora 作为 Google 服务替代的 GrapheneOS 用户。此举加剧了隐私导向的 Android 派系与 Google 对应用分发控制之间的博弈。也凸显了对 Android 生态由谁来决定可运行软件的持续争议。

items.title_en: The ChatGPT/Codex app bundles a full copy of LibreOffice
items.title_zh: ChatGPT/Codex 应用捆绑 LibreOffice 的完整副本
items.summary_en: A ChatGPT/Codex-based app ships LibreOffice in full, raising questions about dependency bloat and licensing. It also touches on maintenance and update responsibilities.
items.summary_zh: 基于 ChatGPT/Codex 的应用捆绑了 LibreOffice 的完整副本，引发对依赖膨胀、许可合规与分发责任的关注。文章分析将大型开源套件嵌入 AI 工具的潜在风险，以及后续的维护与更新责任。

items.title_en: The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 人工神经网络的涌现符号结构
items.summary_en: The paper argues that large neural networks exhibit emergent symbolic structure that supports compositional reasoning, not just pattern matching. By analyzing trained models, the authors identify circuit-like representations that function as symbols and operators, offering a path to more interpretable AI. This has implications for scaling, alignment, and robust reasoning in future models.
items.summary_zh: 这项工作声称大型神经网络会自发形成类似符号的结构，支持成分化的推理。通过对训练后模型的分析，作者发现类似符号和运算符的电路式表示，为可解释性和鲁棒推理带来新路径。

items.title_en: Check if a file was made with Claude
items.title_zh: 检查一个文件是否由 Claude 生成
items.summary_en: Claude content-check tool assesses whether text was produced by Claude; discusses reliability, false positives, and how such detectors fit into content attribution workflows.
items.summary_zh: Claude 内容检查工具用于判断文本是否由 Claude 生成，讨论可靠性、误报，以及在内容归属工作流中的作用。

items.title_en: SteamdDB Joins Nexus Mods
items.title_zh: SteamDB 加入 Nexus Mods
items.summary_en: SteamDB expanding its catalog to include Nexus Mods entries could streamline mod discovery and cross-service integration for gamers. It hints at a broader trend toward unified mod ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: SteamDB 将扩展至 Nexus Mods 的条目，便利玩家发现与跨平台集成，体现了模块生态的融合趋势。

items.title_en: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
items.title_zh: FBI 调查销售超过1.53亿张驾照的服务
items.summary_en: The FBI probes a service suspected of selling more than 153 million driver’s licenses, illustrating how ID data marketplaces can operate at scale. The case underscores the urgency of improving credential security and monitoring online marketplaces for illicit activity.
items.summary_zh: FBI 正在调查一家疑似销售超过1.53亿张驾照的服务，揭示了身份数据市场如何在大规模运作。此案凸显提升凭证安全和监控在线非法市场的紧迫性。

items.title_en: Async Rust vs RTOS showdown (2022)
items.title_zh: Async Rust 与 RTOS 的对决（2022）
items.summary_en: A detailed comparison of asynchronous Rust versus RTOS for embedded systems, highlighting latency, determinism, memory safety, and ecosystem trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 对嵌入式系统中异步 Rust 与 RTOS 的深入对比，聚焦延迟、确定性、内存安全和生态系统的取舍。

items.title_en: I trained a small transformer in 1.5hrs and it beats many LLMs
items.title_zh: 我用 1.5 小时训练出一个小型 Transformer，超过了许多 LLM
items.summary_en: The author trained a compact transformer in 1.5 hours and achieved performance beatdowns on many LLMs. The result showcases rapid experimentation and the effectiveness of efficient training techniques for small models. It suggests a viable path for hobbyists to prototype capable models quickly.
items.summary_zh: 作者在1.5小时内训练出一个小型 Transformer，并在多项任务上超越了不少大型语言模型。该结果体现了快速试验与高效训练技巧在小模型中的有效性。为爱好者快速原型出具备竞争力的模型提供了一条可行路径。

items.title_en: Quasar 438B: Europe's Leading AI Model
items.title_zh: Quasar 438B：欧洲领先的 AI 模型
items.summary_en: Introduces Quasar 438B as a leading European AI model, outlining architecture, capabilities, and strategic significance for EU AI sovereignty and research collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Quasar 438B 这一欧洲领先的 AI 模型，概述架构、能力及对欧盟 AI 主权与科研协作的意义。

items.title_en: Uber shuts operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect
items.title_zh: Uber 立即停止在尼日利亚和乌干达的运营
items.summary_en: Uber's sudden halt of operations in Nigeria and Uganda sends shockwaves through riders, drivers, and the local gig economy. The move raises questions about regulatory pressure, profitability horizons, and how global platforms balance expansion with country-specific risks. Expect competitive pressure from local mobility apps and evolving policy debates.
items.summary_zh: Uber 突然宣布在尼日利亚和乌干达停止运营，这一举动冲击了用户和司机，以及当地的零工经济。此举引发关于监管压力、盈利前景，以及全球平台如何在不同市场平衡扩张与风险的讨论。本地竞争对手和政策辩论的压力预计将升级。

items.title_en: Introducing Ad Blocker for Firefox on iOS
items.title_zh: 在 iOS 的 Firefox 中推出广告拦截功能
items.summary_en: Firefox on iOS gains an integrated ad blocker, expanding privacy controls on Apple's platform. This moves more browser vendors toward built-in content filtering, improving speed and battery life for readers. It demonstrates ongoing improvements to iOS web tooling that bypasses some mobile ad economics.
items.summary_zh: Mozilla 在 iOS 版 Firefox 中推出广告拦截功能，增强对广告与跟踪的控制，改善隐私与浏览体验。

items.title_en: Altair Basic Interpreter Source Code (1975) [pdf]
items.title_zh: Altair Basic 解释器源代码（1975）[PDF]
items.summary_en: Releasing the original Altair BASIC source code provides a window into early microcomputer software engineering and Microsoft's roots. The document showcases tiny, hand-optimized code and the constraints of 1970s hardware, offering lessons for language design and open-source retrospectives.
items.summary_zh: 公开原始的 Altair BASIC 源代码，为早期微型计算机软件工程与微软起源提供一扇窗。文档展示了极小且经过手工优化的代码，以及 1970 年代硬件条件下的设计取舍，为语言设计与开源史提供珍贵素材。

items.title_en: WebLLM: high-performance in-browser LLM inference engine
items.title_zh: WebLLM：高性能浏览器端 LLM 推理引擎
items.summary_en: A browser-based LLM inference engine that runs locally in the client, enabling private, low-latency prompts without sending data to servers. Discusses architecture, WASM, and performance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 基于浏览器的本地 LLM 推理引擎，支持在客户端私有、低延迟的输入输出，不必将数据送回服务器。介绍架构、WASM 实现及性能权衡。

items.title_en: My local model setup on an M4 Pro Mac Mini
items.title_zh: 在 M4 Pro Mac Mini 上的本地模型部署
items.summary_en: The post details a practical guide to running local LLM inference on an M4 Pro Mac Mini, including setup, tooling (ggml/llama.cpp or MPS), and performance notes. It demonstrates that privacy-preserving local inference on consumer hardware is increasingly viable for developers and researchers.
items.summary_zh: 该文提供在 M4 Pro Mac Mini 上本地运行大模型推理的实用指南，涵盖环境搭建、工具链（如 ggml/llama.cpp 和 MPS）以及性能要点。表明在消费级硬件上本地推理越来越具可行性，有助于开发者和研究者保护隐私。

items.title_en: True Rate of Unemployment
items.title_zh: 真实失业率
items.summary_en: The piece critiques official unemployment metrics, highlighting underemployment, discouraged workers, and misclassification as hidden unemployment. It argues for more nuanced measures to understand labor market health and policy impact. The takeaway for tech readers: hiring dynamics and automation risk depend on how you measure unemployment.
items.summary_zh: 本文批评官方失业指标的局限，指出隐性失业包括兼职但想要全职、被放弃求职者和分类错误等问题。它主张采用更细化的指标来评估劳动力市场健康及政策影响。对科技读者而言，招聘趋势与自动化风险取决于你采用的失业度量方式。

items.title_en: The American Worker vs. the Most Qualified
items.title_zh: 美国工人 vs 最合格者
items.summary_en: Examines how hiring practices favor credentials over actual ability, arguing for reforms to better align opportunities with capability.
items.summary_zh: 分析雇佣实践如何偏好资历而非真实能力，呼吁对招聘与选拔制度进行改革，使机会与能力更紧密对齐。

items.title_en: The Post-AI Internet Doesn't Look Great
items.title_zh: 后AI互联网并不乐观
items.summary_en: An analysis of a web dominated by AI content and agents argues it could degrade signal quality, amplify misinformation, and complicate trust and provenance. It questions whether automation truly improves the long-term health of the internet.
items.summary_zh: 本文认为被 AI 内容和智能代理主导的互联网，可能降低信息质量、助长错误信息、并使信誉与来源追踪变得更加困难，进而影响互联网的健康生态。作者质疑自动化是否真的改善在线体验，还是在某些方面拉低了标准。

items.title_en: Saving money on Google Photos with Immich: Your own personal photo storage
items.title_zh: 用 Immich 自建个人照片存储，省钱于 Google 照片
items.summary_en: Immich offers self-hosted photo storage to replace cloud backends, potentially lower costs and better privacy.
items.summary_zh: Immich 提供自托管的照片存储，可能降低成本、提升隐私。文章介绍搭建要点、优缺点及与 Google 照片的对比。

items.title_en: Earth's organisms developed via evolution. What if the cosmos did, too?
items.title_zh: 地球上的生物通过进化发展；如果整个宇宙也经历进化会怎样？
items.summary_en: Smithsonian piece explores the speculative idea that cosmic evolution could shape the universe much like natural selection shapes life on Earth. It surveys theoretical frameworks linking physics, complexity, and information processing to potential cosmos-wide evolution. The article prompts readers to rethink evolutionary narratives beyond biology and consider the implications for astrobiology and cosmology.
items.summary_zh: Smithsonian 的文章探讨一个富有猜想性的想法：宇宙本身是否也可能经历类似地球生命进化的过程。文章回顾了将物理学、复杂性与信息处理联系起来的理论框架，以及对整个宇宙层面进化的潜在影响。促使读者重新思考超越生物学的进化叙事，并思考对天体生物学与宇宙学的意义。

items.title_en: The Silo · interactive 3D cutaway
items.title_zh: The Silo · 互动3D剖切
items.summary_en: An interactive 3D cutaway showcasing the silo's internal structure and systems, highlighting how modern visualization aids understanding of complex machinery.
items.summary_zh: 一个互动式的3D剖切展示，揭示筒仓内部结构与系统，展示可视化在理解复杂机械中的作用。

items.title_en: A third of Perplexity's citations don't contain the number they're cited for
items.title_zh: Perplexity 引用中有三分之一未标注具体数字
items.summary_en: A citation audit finds many Perplexity references lack the numeric figure they cite, undermining traceability. The result highlights challenges in AI-generated content quality and the need for improved citation hygiene and transparency.
items.summary_zh: 引文审计发现 Perplexity 的大量引用未标注具体数字，削弱可追溯性。结果凸显 AI 生成内容的可考性挑战，以及改进引用规范与透明度的必要性。

items.title_en: Ambient CSS v3 – Blender meets CSS
items.title_zh: Ambient CSS 第3版：Blender 与 CSS 的融合
items.summary_en: Ambient CSS v3 blends Blender-like 3D visuals with CSS, enabling more expressive, shader-like styling directly in stylesheets. This continues a trend toward richer client-side visuals without external tools, shaping how designers prototype UI. The update could influence performance considerations and design workflows.
items.summary_zh: Ambient CSS 第3版将 Blender 风格的三维视觉效果与 CSS 融合，让样式表本身就能实现更具表现力的材质与光影。进一步推动在无需外部工具的情况下实现更丰富的前端视觉效果，影响设计师的原型和工作流。

items.title_en: LLMs: Intelligence vs. Cost
items.title_zh: LLMs：智能与成本
items.summary_en: Analyzes trade-offs between model capability, latency, and price; offers patterns for cost-effective deployments including tiered models, caching, and prompt engineering.
items.summary_zh: 分析模型能力、延迟与成本之间的权衡，给出分层模型、缓存和提示优化等成本效益策略。

items.title_en: Show HN: FrontierHarness Eval – 9 harness, same model, cost per pass varies 17x
items.title_zh: Show HN: FrontierHarness 评测——同一模型的 9 个 harness，每次前向成本相差 17 倍
items.summary_en: Evaluates nine harnesses for the same model and shows wide variation in per-pass cost, driven by runtime choices, hardware, and optimization. Important takeaway for cost-conscious deployment strategies.
items.summary_zh: 对同一模型的九种 harness 进行评测，展示每轮前向成本的巨大差异，受运行环境、硬件和优化策略影响。对成本敏感的部署制定了关键参考。

items.title_en: Movie Scene Map – 13,312 films, series, games, anime and manga
items.title_zh: Movie Scene Map：覆盖 13,312 部影视、剧集、游戏、动漫与漫画的场景库
items.summary_en: Movie Scene Map catalogs 13,312 films, series, games, anime and manga by individual scenes, enabling precise cross-media search. It can aid creators, researchers, and educators looking to study or reference iconic moments. Licensing and data sourcing remain notable questions for such a project.
items.summary_zh: Movie Scene Map 按场景对 13,312 部影视、剧集、游戏、动漫与漫画进行整理，支持精确的跨媒介检索。对创作者、研究者和教育工作者在研究或引用经典场景时很有帮助，但数据来源与许可问题值得关注。

items.title_en: Introducing Muse Spark 1.3
items.title_zh: Muse Spark 1.3 介绍
items.summary_en: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 landing page introduces new capabilities, including improved multimodal reasoning, safety features, and developer tooling, expanding access to advanced AI generation.
items.summary_zh: Meta 公布 Muse Spark 1.3 的新能力与改进，包括多模态推理、安全性提升，以及面向开发者的工具链，扩大对高级 AI 生成的使用门槛。

items.title_en: The creator of Jujutsu has joined ERSC
items.title_zh: Jujutsu 的创建者加入 ERSC
items.summary_en: ERSC welcomes the creator of Jujutsu, signaling collaboration that could influence ML tooling and governance efforts at ERSC. The move could steer ERSC's research directions and bring new perspectives from the Jujutsu project into the organization.
items.summary_zh: Jujutsu 的创始人加入 ERSC，可能在 ML 工具与治理相关工作中带来新视角，并影响 ERSC 的研究方向和项目 agenda。

items.title_en: Fine, I'll build my own text editor
items.title_zh: 好吧，我自己动手打造文本编辑器
items.summary_en: The post chronicles building a personal text editor from scratch to explore editor architecture, including buffers, syntax highlighting, and extensibility.
items.summary_zh: 博主分享从零开始构建个人文本编辑器的过程，聚焦缓冲区、语法高亮和可扩展性等编辑器架构要点。

items.title_en: Atlas: A World Model for Spatial Intelligence
items.title_zh: Atlas：用于空间智能的世界模型
items.summary_en: WorldLabs introduces Atlas, a world model aimed at spatial intelligence, enabling improved spatial reasoning for robotics, navigation, and planning.
items.summary_zh: WorldLabs 推出 Atlas，这是一种面向空间智能的世界模型，提升机器人、导航与规划等任务的空间推理能力。文章介绍了 Atlas 如何构建环境表征与行动决策，对具身 AI 具有潜在影响。

items.title_en: Uber is laying off 10% of staff
items.title_zh: Uber 将裁员 10%
items.summary_en: Uber announces 10% layoffs amid efficiency drive; may impact teams including AI/ML and data science groups, signaling broader tech sector cost-cutting.
items.summary_zh: Uber 宣布裁员 10%，以提高效率，可能影响 AI/ML 与数据科学等团队，反映科技行业的成本削减趋势。

items.title_en: Whistleblower warns Postal Service mail ballot system has catastrophic problems
items.title_zh: 告密者警告邮政服务邮寄投票系统存在灾难性问题
items.summary_en: A whistleblower describes critical flaws in the USPS mail-ballot system, raising concerns about reliability, integrity, and potential impact on elections.
items.summary_zh: 一名吹哨人描述 USPS 邮寄投票系统的关键缺陷，引发对可靠性、完整性及对选举影响的担忧。

items.title_en: Show HN: Running 104GB Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on 48GB Mac with at ~12 tok/s
items.title_zh: Show HN：在 48GB Mac 上以约每秒 12 token 运行 104GB 的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary_en: A 104GB Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model runs on a 48GB Mac with runtime around 12 tokens per second, enabled by memory-efficient offloading and optimizations. The post demonstrates how large models can be squeezed onto consumer hardware with careful engineering. It hints at a future where hobbyists can experiment with very large models on commodity machines.
items.summary_zh: 演示在 48GB 内存的 Mac 上以约每秒 12 个 token 运行 104GB 的 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，靠内存高效的 offloading 与优化技巧实现。该展示表明通过精心设计，甚至大型模型也可在普通硬件上运行。预示着爱好者有望在性价比机器上试验超大模型的未来。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (September 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：谁在招聘？（2026年9月）
items.summary_en: A thread aggregating September 2026 tech job openings across startups and incumbents. It reflects sustained demand in software, AI, cloud, and related roles, with many listings favoring remote work. A quick scan can surface opportunities for job seekers and hiring teams alike.
items.summary_zh: 一个汇总 2026 年9月科技岗位需求的讨论串，覆盖初创公司和大型企业的招聘信息。显示软件、AI、云计算等领域持续高需求，许多岗位标注远程工作选项。为求职者和招聘方提供快速发现机会的渠道。

items.title_en: Banca Etica Suspends A/I's Account While Condemning the Sanctions Behind It
items.title_zh: 伦理银行暂停 A/I 的账户，同时谴责背后的制裁
items.summary_en: A cooperative bank suspends an AI-related account citing sanctions concerns, while criticizing the policy that drove the sanctions. Highlights tensions between financial access, policy, and tech services.
items.summary_zh: 合作银行因制裁问题暂停了与 AI 相关的账户，同时抨击支撑制裁的政策。突显金融准入、政策与科技服务之间的矛盾。

items.title_en: Retirement Is Dead
items.title_zh: 退休已死
items.summary_en: Argues the retirement concept is outdated in the age of longer lifespans and flexible work; implications for savings, social systems, and lifelong learning.
items.summary_zh: 认为在更长寿和灵活工作环境下，传统退休概念已经过时，给储蓄、社会制度和终身学习带来影响。

items.title_en: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
items.title_zh: 通往 Astra 的路径：关键能力与前沿安全防护
items.summary_en: Astra outlines the essential capabilities required for the system and the safeguards being developed to address frontier AI risks. It highlights design principles for reliability, safety, and governance in scalable deployments. The document provides a framework for building robust, responsible AI at scale.
items.summary_zh: 文章列出实现 Astra 所需的核心能力，以及为应对前沿 AI 风险而设计的安全防护。并讨论在可扩展部署中提升可信度、可控性与治理的实践原则。

items.title_en: Show HN: Weedout – Safari extension that hides YouTube AI-labeled videos
items.title_zh: Show HN: Weedout——隐藏 YouTube 的 AI 标注视频的 Safari 扩展
items.summary_en: Weedout is a Safari extension that hides videos labeled by YouTube's AI labeling system. It demonstrates a user-centric approach to content curation and metadata control in an era of automated labeling. The project spotlights growing demand for tools that empower individuals to tailor their viewing experience.
items.summary_zh: Weedout 是一款 Safari 扩展，用于隐藏 YouTube 的 AI 标注视频。它展示了在自动标注日益普及的时代，提升用户对内容和元数据控制的思想。此类工具反映出用户对个性化内容控制的日益需求。

items.title_en: The race to engineer new knobs for the human brain
items.title_zh: 争夺为人脑设计新“旋钮”的竞赛
items.summary_en: Reviews advances in neurotechnology aiming to control or augment brain function; debates safety, ethics, and long-term societal impact of brain-interface innovations.
items.summary_zh: 综述致力于提升人脑功能的神经科技进展，讨论安全性、伦理以及脑机接口创新对社会的长远影响。

items.title_en: The efficient frontier of LLM inference
items.title_zh: LLM 推理的有效前沿
items.summary_en: Explores how to push LLM inference efficiency by balancing model size, quantization, and hardware acceleration; presents a framework for evaluating trade-offs and achieving best overall performance for a given budget.
items.summary_zh: 探讨通过在模型大小、量化和硬件加速之间取舍来提升 LLM 推理效率，提出一个在预算约束下评估权衡并实现最优总体性能的框架。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Nori Robotics (YC S26) – A low-cost humanoid robot for development
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Nori Robotics（YC S26）——面向开发的低成本人形机器人
items.summary_en: Nori Robotics launches a low-cost humanoid robot platform backed by YC, designed for development and experimentation. The affordable robot lowers barriers for researchers and developers to prototype robotics software and hardware integration. It signals growing accessibility in hands-on AI robotics.
items.summary_zh: Nori Robotics 推出以开发为导向的低成本人形机器人平台，并获YC支持。该机器人降低了研究人员和开发者在机器人软件与硬件集成上的门槛，便于原型搭建。反映出人工智能机器人领域日益提升的可及性。

items.title_en: WebFPGA (2019)
items.title_zh: WebFPGA（2019年）
items.summary_en: WebFPGA foregrounds the idea of hardware acceleration and FPGA tooling accessible through the web, dating back to 2019. It explores how browser-based tooling could lower barriers to hardware prototyping and education, blending software-first workflows with hardware concepts.
items.summary_zh: WebFPGA提出在浏览器中实现FPGA工作流与硬件加速的思路，始于2019年。这一方向有望降低硬件原型设计与教育的门槛，将浏览器端的工具箱与硬件概念结合起来。

items.title_en: Refurbishing a Tektronix TDS7104 Oscilloscope
items.title_zh: 翻新 Tektronix TDS7104 示波器
items.summary_en: A hands-on refurbishing project revisits the Tektronix TDS7104 oscilloscope, covering teardown, calibration, and parts sourcing.
items.summary_zh: 这篇动手实操文章记录了对经典 Tektronix TDS7104 示波器的翻新过程，包括拆解、校准以及零件来源。文中点出常见故障点与翻新中的挑战，以及爱好者为何仍能从修复老式仪器中受益。

items.title_en: The Cables That Connect the World
items.title_zh: 连接世界的电缆
items.summary_en: Explores the global network of submarine fiber cables, capacity growth, maintenance challenges, and geopolitical considerations shaping internet resilience.
items.summary_zh: 解析全球海底光缆网络、容量增长、维护挑战以及影响网络韧性的地缘政治因素。

items.title_en: Using jq to format JSON on the clipboard
items.title_zh: 使用 jq 在剪贴板上格式化 JSON
items.summary_en: Shares a tip to pretty-print clipboard JSON by piping through jq, saving steps for developers handling JSON data.
items.summary_zh: 分享通过将剪贴板内容管道传给 jq 来美化 JSON 的技巧，简化开发工作流。

items.title_en: Show HN: HN Match Maker – Matching "Who Wants to Be Hired?" With "Who's Hiring?"
items.title_zh: Show HN: HN Match Maker——将“Who Wants to Be Hired?”与“Who's Hiring?”对接
items.summary_en: HN Match Maker pairs posts labeled as 'Who Wants to Be Hired?' with those labeled 'Who's Hiring?', creating a lightweight, community-driven job-matching workflow. It demonstrates how informal signals on a tech community site can streamline recruitment. The project underscores the value of frictionless, local hiring tools.
items.summary_zh: HN Match Maker 是一个将求职贴『Who Wants to Be Hired?』与招聘贴『Who's Hiring?』进行匹配的工具，利用社群信息促进招聘与求职的对接。它体现了社区驱动的招聘工具能降低信息检索成本。此类本地化协作工具在技术社群中具备一定吸引力。

items.title_en: Io_uring Without Readahead
items.title_zh: Io_uring：不使用 Readahead
items.summary_en: This piece argues for running io_uring without readahead in certain workloads to reduce latency and memory pressure. It discusses when readahead helps versus when it hurts and offers practical tuning tips for Linux I/O paths. A solid read for systems engineers optimizing storage-heavy apps.
items.summary_zh: 文中提出在特定工作负载下可让 io_uring 跳过预读取以降低延迟和内存压力。讨论了何时预读取有帮助、何时会带来负担，并给出 Linux I/O 路径的实用调优建议。对优化存储密集型应用的系统工程师很有价值。

items.title_en: Wendell Berry has died
items.title_zh: 温德尔·贝瑞逝世
items.summary_en: Renowned poet and environmental writer Wendell Berry died at 94. His work on farming, community, and critiques of modern technology shaped American literature and ecological thought.
items.summary_zh: 著名诗人兼环保作家温德尔·贝瑞去世，享年94岁。他的作品聚焦乡村生活、社区价值，以及对现代技术的批评，对美国家文学与生态思想产生深远影响。

items.title_en: We could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora
items.title_zh: 用 Zstandard 与 Pingora 节省缓存存储量
items.summary_en: Cloudflare describes how combining Zstandard compression with Pingora caching can drastically reduce cache storage and bandwidth for serving content.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 说明将 Zstandard 压缩与 Pingora 缓存结合使用，可以显著降低缓存存储需求和带宽成本，提升缓存系统效率。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (September 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN: 谁愿意被雇用？（2026 年 9 月）
items.summary_en: A Hacker News thread crowdsources who is open to job offers, often revealing market demand, location preferences, compensation ranges, and remote-work norms. It serves as a pulse check for engineers evaluating opportunities and recruiters scouting talent.
items.summary_zh: 这是 Hacker News 的一个征求愿意被雇用的求职贴，常暴露出市场对技能、薪资、地理位置和远程工作偏好的趋势。对求职者和招聘者都提供了有价值的市场信号。

items.title_en: A Selection of Los Alamos Rolodex Business Cards
items.title_zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯 Rolodex 名片精选
items.summary_en: A curated glimpse into scientists’ networks from Los Alamos through historical business cards; reveals collaboration webs, institutional culture, and design of professional cards from the era.
items.summary_zh: 通过历史名片展现洛斯阿拉莫斯科学家之间的网络与合作文化，提供对当时专业名片设计与机构氛围的珍贵一瞥。

items.title_en: Reverse Engineering Unknown File Formats with ImHex
items.title_zh: 使用 ImHex 逆向未知文件格式
items.summary_en: ImHex offers templates and tooling to reverse engineer unknown binary formats. The post demonstrates practical techniques for inferring structure, extracting fields, and automating format recognition, underscoring the value of template-driven analysis in malware and forensics contexts. It also shows how to capture endianess, alignment, and nested blocks.
items.summary_zh: ImHex 提供模板与工具，用于逆向未知二进制格式。文章演示了通过结构推断、字段提取与格式自动识别的实用技巧，强调在恶意软件分析与取证场景中模板驱动分析的价值，还涉及字节序、对齐与嵌套块等要点。

items.title_en: Engineering of the fastest WebAssembly interpreters
items.title_zh: 最快的 WebAssembly 解释器的工程实现
items.summary_en: A design-focused look at Wasmi v2.0 and the engineering choices behind a high-performance WASM interpreter. It covers optimizations, memory model handling, and architecture decisions enabling speed at the cost of complexity, with implications for edge runtimes and blockchain smart contracts.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦 Wasmi v2.0 的设计与实现，解读高性能 WASM 解释器背后的工程取舍。内容涵盖优化、内存模型处理及推动边缘运行时与区块链智能合约性能的架构决策及其代价。

items.title_en: Show HN: OwnTime – a chess clock for your day's priorities
items.title_zh: Show HN：OwnTime——为每日优先事项设计的计时棋钟
items.summary_en: OwnTime visualizes daily priorities as time blocks, turning tasks into moves on a clock-like interface. It aims to help users manage focus and daily planning more effectively.
items.summary_zh: OwnTime 将每日优先事项可视化为时间块，将任务转化为类似棋盘的时间移动，帮助用户更高效地管理专注与日程。

items.title_en: Holden's Lightning Flight
items.title_zh: 霍尔登的闪电飞行
items.summary_en: A historical account of Holden's bold high-speed flight, illustrating the daring of early aviation and the risks of pioneering experiments. It covers the aircraft design, weather conditions, and the era's scientific curiosity.
items.summary_zh: 讲述霍尔登进行高速飞行的历史事件，展示早期航空探索的勇气与冒险。文中回顾相关的飞机设计、天气因素及当时的科技热情。

items.title_en: We are rebuilding Monica
items.title_zh: We Are Rebuilding Monica
items.summary_en: Monica, the self-hosted personal CRM, is undergoing a rebuild to modernize its architecture and features. The update aims to improve performance, data privacy, and offline usage, appealing to privacy-conscious knowledge workers. It highlights ongoing interest in self-hosted productivity tools.
items.summary_zh: 自托管个人 CRM 的 Monica 正在重建，以更新架构与功能。改版聚焦提升性能、数据隐私与离线使用体验，吸引注重隐私的知识工作者。体现出对自托管生产力工具的持续兴趣。

items.title_en: Fluorescent lamps (don't) have ears
items.title_zh: 荧光灯没有耳朵
items.summary_en: Questions the notion that fluorescent lighting devices can listen or secretly collect data, placing such claims in historical and technical perspective. It separates myth from reality and offers guidance on evaluating surveillance rumors around everyday tech.
items.summary_zh: 文章质疑荧光灯会监听等说法，指出普通灯具并没有监听功能。文中回顾了关于照明设备与数据收集的传言的历史背景，并强调对夸大说法保持怀疑，同时提供评估日常科技监控传闻的要点。

items.title_en: What's within a 10-minute walk in 50 European cities
items.title_zh: 50个欧洲城市十分钟步行范围
items.summary_en: This study maps what lies within a 10-minute walk across 50 European cities, highlighting walkability gaps and the implications for urban design, transit, and livability.
items.summary_zh: 研究覆盖50个欧洲城市，绘出从核心点出发步行十分钟可达的区域，揭示步行可达性的差异及其对城市设计、交通与宜居性的影响。

items.title_en: Higher Multipoles of the Cow
items.title_zh: 牛的高阶多极矩
items.summary_en: A physics preprint exploring higher multipole contributions in the COW (Colella-Overhauser-Werner) experiment, shedding light on precision tests of gravitational interaction with quantum systems.
items.summary_zh: 一篇物理学预印本，探讨 COW 实验中的高阶多极项，对将引力与量子系统相耦合的精确测试具有意义。

items.title_en: Making the Internet Boring
items.title_zh: 让互联网变得无聊
items.summary_en: A provocative essay arguing that making the internet boring could reduce scams, surveillance, and sensationalism, by redesigning incentives and interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章提出通过改变激励和界面设计，让互联网变得“无聊”，从而减少骗局、监控和喧嚣化现象。

items.title_en: Sonic Pi
items.title_zh: Sonic Pi：音乐编程环境
items.summary_en: Sonic Pi is a live-coding environment for crafting music with code, blending education and creative experimentation.
items.summary_zh: Sonic Pi 是一个用代码创作音乐的现场编码环境，将教育与创意实验结合。文章强调其设计理念、社区资源，以及如何降低音乐编程的门槛。

items.title_en: The shrinking landscape of linguistic diversity in the age of LLMs
items.title_zh: 在大型语言模型时代语言多样性的缩小
items.summary_en: As language models become dominant, many languages lose digital presence and resources, shrinking linguistic diversity.
items.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型的普及，许多语言在数字世界的存在与资源减少，语言多样性正趋于缩小。文章总结了相关证据并呼吁加强政策与研究支持以保护小语种。

items.title_en: Top Web Design Styles of 1993
items.title_zh: 1993年的顶级网页设计风格
items.summary_en: A look back at early web aesthetics from 1993—marquee effects, rainbow headers, and plain text links—showing how constraints shaped early UX and seeded the web’s evolving visual language.
items.summary_zh: 回望1993年的早期网页美学——跑马灯效、彩虹标题与纯文本链接，揭示当时的约束如何塑造初期用户体验并孕育现代网页设计的雏形。该文揭示了现代网页美学的早期起源。

items.title_en: Discontinuation of third level domain registrations for the .name TLD [pdf]
items.title_zh: .name 顶级域名将停止注册三级域名（PDF）
items.summary_en: ICANN policy document outlines ending third-level registrations for the .name domain, affecting personal branding formats like first.last.name. It signals registration policy changes and potential migration needs.
items.summary_zh: ICANN 的政策文件宣布停止 .name 域名的三级域名注册，影响如 name 作为个人品牌的用法，并提示注册规则的变动和潜在的迁移需求。

items.title_en: Magic eye tube
items.title_zh: 魔术眼管
items.summary_en: The Magic Eye tube is a neon indicator used in vintage gear to visualize signal strength. It operates by the phosphor-lit window bending with amplitude, offering a nostalgic look at pre-digital level meters.
items.summary_zh: 魔术眼管是一种用于 vintage 设备的氖管指示器，通过发光窗口的形变来可视化信号强度，提供了数字显示普及前的怀旧电平表视图。

items.title_en: Solving the Flat Cube
items.title_zh: 解平面立方
items.summary_en: The post presents a geometry puzzle about solving the flat cube and lays out a method to solve it, with geometric intuition and step-by-step reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 文中给出平面立方相关的几何难题及其解法，结合直观几何思路提供分步推理。

items.title_en: AI, ex-Soviet engineers, and the Holy Grail of rocketry
items.title_zh: AI、前苏联工程师与火箭科学的圣杯
items.summary_en: Examines how AI is influencing rocket design, drawing on experiences of ex-Soviet engineers; discusses breakthroughs and potential safety and ethics concerns.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 如何影响火箭设计，结合前苏联工程师的经验，讨论潜在突破与安全伦理问题。

items.title_en: How bicycle coaster brakes work (2018)
items.title_zh: 自行车脚踏内置后制动的工作原理（2018）
items.summary_en: The article explains how coaster brakes engage when the rider pedals backward, using a pawl-and-ratchet mechanism to apply braking force. It also covers maintenance tips and common issues.
items.summary_zh: 本文解释了脚踏内置后制动在踩后踏时如何工作，利用棘爪与棘轮机构将力转化为制动。还给出维护要点与常见问题。

items.title_en: Building an interactive instrument for a one-of-a-kind festival
items.title_zh: 为独特节日打造的互动乐器
items.summary_en: Details a build of an interactive instrument for a unique festival, covering hardware choices, sensor inputs, and how attendees shape the sound. It highlights the blend of art and engineering in live installations.
items.summary_zh: 介绍为一场独特的节日打造的互动乐器，涉及硬件选型、传感输入以及观众共同生成声音的方式，展示现场装置中的艺术与工程融合。

items.title_en: Building Autonomous Goal Loops That Deliver
items.title_zh: 构建自治目标循环以实现成果
items.summary_en: Outlines a design pattern for autonomous goal loops in agents, including loop structure, feedback, and safeguards to ensure productive progress toward concrete tasks. The article emphasizes practical deployment and reliability.
items.summary_zh: 提出一种面向自主代理的目标循环设计模式，涵盖循环结构、反馈机制和安全措施，确保朝着具体任务稳定推进，并强调落地与可靠性。

items.title_en: Forgotten History of Small Nuclear Reactors (2015)
items.title_zh: 小型核反应堆的被遗忘历史（2015）
items.summary_en: The article revisits the rise and fall of small modular reactors, tracing policy debates, safety concerns, and economic challenges that limited early deployment. It explains why modular reactor concepts persist and what they could mean for future energy grids.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾小型模块化核反应堆的兴衰，梳理政策辩论、安全性和经济挑战为何限制早期部署，并讨论这类概念为何仍具潜力以及对未来电网的影响。

items.title_en: Open Battery Information
items.title_zh: 开放式电池信息
items.summary_en: Open Battery Information is a community-driven project that standardizes battery metadata—chemistry, health, and performance—via open specifications. This openness helps cross-device interoperability and transparency across consumer electronics and energy storage.
items.summary_zh: 开放式电池信息是一个以社区为驱动的项目，利用开放规范统一电池元数据（化学成分、健康状态、性能等）。开放的数据有助于实现跨设备互操作性与能源存储领域的透明度。

items.title_en: Laurie Anderson’s next manuscript to be locked away for 88 years
items.title_zh: Laurie Anderson 的下一部手稿将被鎖存 88 年
items.summary_en: Guardian reports that Laurie Anderson’s forthcoming manuscript will be archived for 88 years as part of the Future Library project, raising questions about authorship, curation, and long-term literary preservation.
items.summary_zh: 《卫报》报道劳里·安德森的下一部手稿将被置入未来图书馆并锁存88年，引发关于作者身份、策展以及长期文学保存的讨论。
